attributes.context: The clause appears immediately after the section heading “10-107 Automation and/or Technological Change” in the provided CBA text.

extraction_text: 10-108 The Employer and the Union will carefully review the status of any employees displaced by automation and/or technological change. The Employer will review the status of employees affected by such changes in order to provide suitable retraining or alternate employment wherever practicable. Any mutually agreed placement shall not be construed to violate this Agreement.

attributes.context: The surrounding text describes a standard CBA clause that memorializes the parties' agreement on employer authority for technological changes and notes it may be based on the NLRA or used by private or public sector employers.

extraction_text: the employer's right to introduce new technology or work processes, including labor-saving automation, during the CBA's term
